test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: Four letter - clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter - cluster.
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] 

1) ROLIF → R - 3 = O; O - 3 = L; L - 3 = I; I - 3 = F

2) TQNKH → T - 3 = Q; Q - 3 = N; N - 3 = K; K - 3 = H

3) YWUSQ → Y - 2 = W; W - 2 = U; U - 2 = S; S - 2 = Q 

4) VSPMJ → V - 3 = S; S - 3 = P; P - 3 = M; M - 3 = J

Hence, ‘**YWUSQ**’ is the odd one out.
